summary: First iteration testing of GitHub Mobile Client app. Backend API testing: 17/18 tests passed (94.4% success). Frontend UI testing: All core screens render correctly with proper mobile design. Critical issue: tabs accessible without authentication.

minor.issue: Empty token causes 500 Internal Server Error instead of proper 401/422 validation error

integration_issues.issue: Tab screens (/(tabs)/) are accessible without authentication. Users can navigate to Home, Search, and Profile tabs without logging in, resulting in blank screens or loading states. The login screen has redirect logic, but the tab routes themselves lack auth protection.

tabBarTestID props (tab-home, tab-search, tab-profile) defined in (tabs)/_layout.tsx are not rendering as data-testid attributes on the actual tab buttons. Tabs are only accessible by text content, not by testID.

action_items: Add route protection to (tabs) layout - redirect to login if user is null/not authenticated
Fix empty token validation in POST /api/auth/login to return 401/422 instead of 500
Investigate why tabBarTestID is not rendering as data-testid on tab buttons (may be Expo Router limitation)
Consider adding loading/error states to tab screens when accessed without auth (instead of blank screens)
critical_code_review_comments: Auth protection missing on tab routes - users can access /(tabs)/ without login
Profile screen returns null when user is not logged in, causing blank screen
Home screen tries to fetch repos without token, causing loading state
All backend endpoints properly require authentication (422 without header, 401 with invalid token)
Login screen error handling works correctly - shows 'Invalid GitHub token' message
Mobile design is excellent - touch targets meet 44px minimum, good contrast, proper spacing
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Testing performed with invalid tokens only (no valid GitHub token available).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This app requires a valid GitHub Personal Access Token for full testing. Without a real token, only error handling and UI rendering can be tested. The main issue is missing auth protection on tab routes. Once fixed, retest with a valid token to verify full user flows (login → repos list → repo detail → file viewer).
rca_of_issue: Root cause of auth protection issue: The login screen (index.tsx) has a useEffect that redirects authenticated users to /(tabs), but there is no corresponding protection in the (tabs) layout or individual tab screens to redirect unauthenticated users back to login. This allows direct URL access to tab screens without authentication, resulting in blank screens (profile) or perpetual loading states (home repos list) because the API calls fail without a valid token.
